desktopFinalPrompt:
Use case: compositing
Asset type: photorealistic desktop landing-page hero, 1768 x 890 landscape.
Image 1 is the EXISTING HERO SCENE, used ONLY for environment, lighting, arrangement, product scale, and dark negative space. Image 2 is the user's LOCKED PRODUCT DESIGN and is the sole authority for all product geometry, finishes, and parts. Replace the earbuds and inline controller in image 1 with the exact devices from image 2. Do not blend the old earbud architecture with the new one.

LOCKED PRODUCT IDENTITY FROM IMAGE 2:
• Compact organically sculpted SMOKED TRANSLUCENT charcoal shells, showing subtle internal structures through tinted resin. They are not opaque stacked metal cylinders.
• The outward face is a gently domed slightly oval MATTE, finely textured black faceplate with a slim polished champagne perimeter bezel. No radial-brushed silver or gunmetal disc.
• A substantial soft textured BLACK silicone stabilization fin curves upward, broad at its base and tapering to a rounded hooked end, as in image 2. The fin is completely plain black: ABSOLUTELY NO gold pads or sensor elements on either fin.
• The INNER BODY surface, below the fin, has a compact black inset panel with TWO vertically arranged oval pale champagne contacts at its left and a small vertical rounded-rectangular green optical sensor window beside them on the right. Tiny dark apertures as visible in the reference. These contacts belong on the inner housing, NOT on the fin, outer faceplate, or cable.
• A short black acoustic nozzle on the inner side carries one soft smoke-grey silicone tip. On the visible inner-facing bud's tip there are TWO narrow champagne pill-shaped electrode insets on its outer silicone surface and a dark mesh sound bore at the end. Match image 2; remove the old hero's oversized black square blocks on tips.
• Fine black braided cables exit from short tapered black strain reliefs below the shells.
• Match the locked long rounded dark inline controller with three distinct raised buttons in a row: minus, central multipurpose/phone button, plus; one tiny white indicator to their right. Replace the hero's obsolete single-round-button controller. Keep the outgoing cable continuing naturally toward the right edge; the USB-C terminal may remain out of frame to preserve composition.

CAMERA / PRODUCT POSES:
Place the near bud at the existing center-left position, roughly x42%, y45%, with its matte black OUTER faceplate toward the camera and translucent side shell and rear tip visible, like the LEFT bud in image 2. Place the farther bud at the existing center-right position, roughly x57%, y39%, but rotate it to show its INNER contact/sensor panel to the camera, like the RIGHT bud in image 2. Its green optical window and two oval body contacts must be readable and its silicone tip points to camera-right. This rotation is intentional and necessary. Keep both buds approximately the same size as the originals; show one outer view and one inner view of the same design, not two different designs. Both fins remain plain black.

SCENE INVARIANTS:
Keep image 1's huge warm bronze circular backdrop, luminous arc, black studio, curved textured dark stone plinth, perspective, camera height, soft warm shadows, foreground braided cable arcs, and controller position on the right. Preserve all top navigation space and the entire near-black bottom third for live webpage copy. Preserve framing and image aspect ratio. Update local product shadows/reflections naturally. The light-colored background of image 2 must NOT appear; integrate these precise products into the dark hero lighting. Keep enough restrained fill light to reveal the smoked resin, inner contacts, green optical window and matte texture without making them neon.

No text, logos, UI, labels, arrows, watermark, extra buds or unrelated objects. Exact product identity transfer is more important than retaining the old earbud shape.
Image 3 is the successfully corrected MOBILE version of this same hero campaign. Use it as an additional consistency check for the exact product identity, the outer-view/inner-view pairing, and the three-button controller, while retaining the WIDE landscape composition of image 1. Do not copy image 3's portrait crop.
purpose: Replace hero products with the user's locked design, retaining the existing hero lighting and composition.
supersedes: Prior hero and technology render geometry; the user-provided locked reference determines fin, inner contacts/sensor, shell, faceplate, tip and controller architecture.
